findings.title: init() never adds Clients scopes/resources to existing realms
findings.body: AdminPermissionsSchema.init() returns immediately if realm.getAdminPermissionsClient() already exists. Realms created before the Clients type existed therefore never get the new scopes (configure, map-roles-client-scope, map-roles-composite, etc.) or the 'Clients' all-resource. Creating a Clients scope permission on such a realm then fails in getOrCreateResource with ModelException No scopes found, and global Clients checks return false. Init must be idempotent and add missing scopes/resources on upgrade.

findings.title: NPE when all-clients resource is missing
findings.body: ClientPermissionsV2.hasPermission(ClientModel,String) falls back to AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceTypeResource() when no per-client resource exists. That helper can return null if the Clients type resource was deleted or schema checks fail. The code then calls findByResource(server, null) and later new ResourcePermission(null, ...) without a null check, causing NullPointerException and HTTP 500 on any client permission check. A null guard returning false is required.

findings.title: Per-client check ignores all-clients grant when specific resource exists
findings.body: ClientPermissionsV2.hasPermission(ClientModel,String) looks up the per-client resource by client id. If it exists it evaluates only that resource; the Clients type (all-clients) resource is only evaluated when the per-client resource is absent. Example: grant view on client A creating its resource, then grant manage on all clients. A check for manage on A finds A's resource, sees only view, and denies despite the all-clients manage grant. Both the specific and the type resources must be evaluated with OR semantics.

findings.title: Client removal listener throws with V2 permissions
findings.body: AdminPermissions.registerListener() calls management(...).clients().setPermissionsEnabled(client,false) on ClientRemovedEvent. When ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 is enabled management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 whose clients() is now ClientPermissionsV2, whose setPermissionsEnabled unconditionally throws UnsupportedOperationException. The listener is gated only on ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ, so with both features enabled deleting any client throws from the event listener; with only V2 enabled orphan authz resources leak. V2 needs a proper cleanup or no-op path.

findings.title: getResourceName has no Clients branch
findings.body: AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceName() special-cases only the Users type, returning All users or the username. For the new Clients type it falls through to resource.getDisplayName(), which is null for resources created by getOrCreateResource that stores the client UUID as name. Client permission UI therefore shows null instead of All clients or the clientId. A Clients branch mirroring the Users branch is missing.

findings.title: getScope NPE on unknown resourceType
findings.body: AdminPermissionsSchema.getScope() does SCHEMA.getResourceTypes().get(resourceType).getScopes() without checking that resourceType exists. An unknown or null resourceType causes NullPointerException instead of ModelValidationException, turning a bad request into HTTP 500. A null check is needed before dereferencing.

findings.title: requireView docs say Returns instead of Throws
findings.body: ClientPermissionEvaluator.requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() are void methods that throw ForbiddenException on denial, but their Javadoc says Returns true if canView returns true, copied from the can* methods. Readers will expect a boolean return. The docs must say Throws ForbiddenException if the corresponding can* returns false.
